begin read only; set local statement_timeout='3s'; set local lock_timeout='500ms';
select now() as observed_at,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
'fabric_id',f.fabric_id,'colour_name',f.colour_name,
'supplier_brands',jsonb_build_object('display_name',b.display_name),
'fabric_designs',jsonb_build_object('display_name',d.display_name,'composition',d.composition,'full_width_mm',d.full_width_mm,'usable_width_mm',d.usable_width_mm,'vertical_repeat_mm',d.vertical_repeat_mm,'horizontal_repeat_mm',d.horizontal_repeat_mm,'pattern_match_type',d.pattern_match_type,'usage_suitability',d.usage_suitability,'weight_gsm',d.weight_gsm,'care_instructions',d.care_instructions,'fabric_collections',jsonb_build_object('display_name',c.display_name)),
'visual',jsonb_build_object('knowledge_state',v.knowledge_state,'visual_fields',v.visual_fields),
'profile',jsonb_build_object('description',p.description,'description_validated',p.description_validated)
) order by f.fabric_id) as records
from curtainsuk_private.fabric_colourways f
left join curtainsuk_private.fabric_designs d on d.design_id=f.design_id
left join curtainsuk_private.fabric_collections c on c.collection_id=d.collection_id
left join curtainsuk_private.supplier_brands b on b.brand_id=f.brand_id
left join curtainsuk_private.fabric_visual_knowledge_read_cache v on v.fabric_id=f.fabric_id
left join curtainsuk_private.fabric_retail_profiles p on p.fabric_id=f.fabric_id
where f.fabric_id=any(array['pt-1200-907','pt-1204-212','pt-1223-374','pt-1224-002','pt-1225-314','pt-1225-722']); rollback;
resourcePreflightAndPostflight:
begin read only; set local statement_timeout='3s';
select jsonb_build_object(
'checked_at',clock_timestamp(),'database_bytes',pg_database_size(current_database()),
'connections',(select count(*) from pg_stat_activity),
'max_connections',current_setting('max_connections')::int,
'lock_waiters',(select count(*) from pg_stat_activity where wait_event_type='Lock'),
'other_active',(select count(*) from pg_stat_activity where state='active' and pid<>pg_backend_pid()),
'indexed',(select count(*) from advisory.knowledge_search),
'jobs',(select count(*) from advisory.index_jobs),
'migration_count',(select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
'migration_hash',(select encode(sha256(convert_to(array_to_string(statements,E'\n'),'UTF8')),'hex') from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version='20261011171354'),
'stats',(select row_to_json(s) from (select blks_read,blks_hit,temp_bytes,deadlocks,stats_reset from pg_stat_database where datname=current_database()) s),
'indexer_memberships',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid),'member',pg_get_userbyid(member),'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(grantor),'admin',admin_option,'inherit',inherit_option,'set',set_option)) from pg_auth_members where roleid='advisory_indexer'::regrole),
'can_set_indexer',pg_has_role(current_user,'advisory_indexer','SET')) as receipt; commit;
verification:
begin read only; set local statement_timeout='3s';
select jsonb_build_object(
'checked_at',clock_timestamp(),
'job',(select row_to_json(j) from advisory.index_jobs j where id='a6c0d329-935e-4c31-b8ef-71a52f6d9149'),
'items',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',k.fabric_id,'hash',k.source_hash,'receiptHash',i.after_hash,'beforeRow',i.before_row,'fields',i.fields,'indexedAt',k.indexed_at,'vectors',jsonb_build_object('document',k.document::text,'colour',k.colour::text,'pattern',k.pattern::text,'texture',k.texture::text,'composition',k.composition::text)) order by k.fabric_id) from advisory.knowledge_search k join advisory.index_job_items i using(fabric_id) where i.job_id='a6c0d329-935e-4c31-b8ef-71a52f6d9149'),
'gate',(select row_to_json(g) from advisory.index_gate g where id=1),
'relation_bytes',(select jsonb_object_agg(c.relname,pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='advisory' and c.relkind='r'),
'public_schema_access',jsonb_build_object('anon',has_schema_privilege('anon','advisory','USAGE'),'authenticated',has_schema_privilege('authenticated','advisory','USAGE'),'service_role',has_schema_privilege('service_role','advisory','USAGE')),
'indexer_auth_access',has_schema_privilege('advisory_indexer','auth','USAGE'),
'indexer_session_access',has_table_privilege('advisory_indexer','advisory.consultations','SELECT'),
'runtime_index_write',has_table_privilege('advisory_runtime','advisory.knowledge_search','INSERT')
) as verification; rollback;
